purpose: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — city already has a real, verified provider (GeoNames, via MasterDataRefreshUseCase.refreshCities()) and is not wired to the AI-acquisition endpoint. This definition exists so every master type Integration currently supports has a recorded prompt shape, per the task's own requirement, not because AI should originate city data.
scope: Not used to call any AI provider today. If ever needed as a last-resort draft path when GeoNames is unavailable, scope would be limited to real, existing, named cities only.

fieldFormats.name: The city's common English name.
fieldFormats.evidence: One sentence on the coordinate source — never treated as independent verification; a candidate this prompt produced would stay UNVERIFIED, since no fixed allowed-values list or independently-checkable rule exists for arbitrary coordinates.

evidenceRequirements: State the reasoning source in one sentence. Never independently verifiable the way a fixed code list is — a proposal for this master type would stay UNVERIFIED even after human acceptance would need to re-check coordinates against GeoNames itself before use.
exampleResponse: [{"name":"Example City","countryCode":"IN","latitude":18.52,"longitude":73.85,"evidence":"Commonly known coordinates for this city center."}]
